snippet.title: A tour of the Black Emporium - details in Dragon Age: Inquisition
snippet.description: Details in Dragon Age: Inquisition. Let me take you on a tour of The Black Emporium. The Black Emporium DLC is available for free on Origin, PlayStation Network and Xbox Live. You can acces it through the war table operation The Black Emporium that costs 0 power. In the Black Emporium you will find four stores that sell epic weapons, accessories, crafting materials and schematics. You can also change your appearance/face with the Mirror of Transformation.
